set -u
COPIA_TMP="/tmp/eval-wb/sut-p1-eval"
cd "$COPIA_TMP"
EVAL_DIR="/tmp/eval-wb/run-p1"
rm -rf "$EVAL_DIR"
mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR"
USDC="${EVAL_USDC_ADDRESS:-0xe7f1725E7734CE288F8367e1Bb143E90bb3F0512}"
RPC="${EVAL_RPC_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8545}"
MNEMONIC_24_VALIDO="abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon art"
MNEMONIC_24_CHECKSUM_INVALIDO="abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon"
MNEMONIC_BIP39_CANONICO="abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about"
MNEMONIC_24_PALABRA_INVALIDA="abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon xyzzy"

start_ok() {
  local name="$1" port="$2" db="$3"
  shift 3
  local key
  key="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
  local log="$EVAL_DIR/${name}.log"
  local envfile="$EVAL_DIR/${name}.env"
  cat > "$envfile" <<EOF
HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=$port
DATABASE_PATH=$db
SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=3600
WALLET_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$key
USDC_TOKEN_ADDRESS=$USDC
RPC_URL=$RPC
EOF
  ( set -a; source "$envfile"; set +a
    "$@"
    exec npx tsx src/server.ts ) >"$log" 2>&1 &
  local pid=$!
  echo "$pid" > "$EVAL_DIR/${name}.pid"
  echo "$key" > "$EVAL_DIR/${name}.key"
  for i in $(seq 1 40); do
    if curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${port}/health" >/dev/null; then
      echo "READY $name pid=$pid port=$port"
      return 0
    fi
    if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "DEAD $name"
      echo "----- log -----"
      cat "$log"
      return 1
    fi
    sleep 0.25
  done
  echo "TIMEOUT $name"
  cat "$log"
  return 1
}

stop_name() {
  local name="$1"
  local pidfile="$EVAL_DIR/${name}.pid"
  if [[ -f "$pidfile" ]]; then
    local pid
    pid="$(cat "$pidfile")"
    kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f "$pidfile"
  fi
}

run_abort() {
  local name="$1"
  shift
  local db="$EVAL_DIR/${name}.sqlite"
  local log="$EVAL_DIR/${name}.stderr"
  local key="${ABORT_KEY:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}"
  (
    export HOST=127.0.0.1
    export PORT=13990
    export DATABASE_PATH="$db"
    export SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=3600
    export WALLET_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$key"
    export USDC_TOKEN_ADDRESS="$USDC"
    export RPC_URL="$RPC"
    "$@"
    npx tsx src/server.ts
  ) >"$log" 2>"$EVAL_DIR/${name}.err" &
  local pid=$!
  local waited=0
  while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && [[ $waited -lt 20 ]]; do
    sleep 0.5
    waited=$((waited+1))
  done
  if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "$name HUNG"
    echo EXIT=hung
  else
    wait "$pid"
    echo EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- stdout ---"
  cat "$log"
  echo "--- stderr ---"
  cat "$EVAL_DIR/${name}.err"
  echo "--- wallet_secret ---"
  if [[ -f "$db" ]]; then
    python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3, os
p="$db"
con=sqlite3.connect(p)
try:
    n=con.execute("select count(*) from wallet_secret").fetchone()[0]
    print("wallet_secret_count", n)
except Exception as e:
    print("db_error", e)
PY
  else
    echo "no db file"
  fi
}

echo "========== AT-06-01-05 abort checksum =========="
run_abort abort-checksum env WALLET_MNEMONIC="$MNEMONIC_24_CHECKSUM_INVALIDO"

echo "========== AT-06-01-09 abort 12 words =========="
run_abort abort-12 env WALLET_MNEMONIC="$MNEMONIC_BIP39_CANONICO"

echo "========== AT-06-01-10 abort xyzzy =========="
run_abort abort-xyzzy env WALLET_MNEMONIC="$MNEMONIC_24_PALABRA_INVALIDA"

echo "========== AT-06-01-04 I1 =========="
mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR/i1" "$EVAL_DIR/i2"
if start_ok i1 13311 "$EVAL_DIR/i1/exchange.sqlite"; then
  EMAIL1="i1-$(date +%s)@example.com"
  curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13311/api/v1/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAIL1\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/i1-reg.json"
  echo
  TOKEN1="$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13311/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAIL1\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["token"])')"
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN1" "http://127.0.0.1:13311/api/v1/deposit-address?asset=ETH" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/i1-addr.json"
  echo
  stop_name i1
  rm -rf "$EVAL_DIR/i1"
fi

echo "========== AT-06-01-04 I2 =========="
if start_ok i2 13312 "$EVAL_DIR/i2/exchange.sqlite"; then
  EMAIL2="i2-$(date +%s)@example.com"
  curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13312/api/v1/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAIL2\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/i2-reg.json"
  echo
  TOKEN2="$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13312/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAIL2\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["token"])')"
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN2" "http://127.0.0.1:13312/api/v1/deposit-address?asset=ETH" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/i2-addr.json"
  echo
  stop_name i2
  rm -rf "$EVAL_DIR/i2"
fi

echo "========== AT-06-01-11 provision then missing/wrong key =========="
mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR/cred"
KEY_OK="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
if ABORT_KEY="$KEY_OK" start_ok cred 13313 "$EVAL_DIR/cred/exchange.sqlite"; then
  python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3, hashlib, pathlib
p="$EVAL_DIR/cred/exchange.sqlite"
con=sqlite3.connect(p)
blob=con.execute("select encrypted_seed from wallet_secret where singleton_id=1").fetchone()[0]
open("$EVAL_DIR/cred/blob.bin","wb").write(blob)
print("blob_len", len(blob), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest())
PY
  stop_name cred
  echo "--- missing key ---"
  (
    export HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=13991 DATABASE_PATH="$EVAL_DIR/cred/exchange.sqlite" SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=3600
    unset WALLET_ENCRYPTION_KEY || true
    export USDC_TOKEN_ADDRESS="$USDC" RPC_URL="$RPC"
    npx tsx src/server.ts
  ) >"$EVAL_DIR/cred-missing.out" 2>"$EVAL_DIR/cred-missing.err" &
  pid=$!
  sleep 3
  if kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then echo MISSING_HUNG; kill -9 $pid; wait $pid 2>/dev/null; else wait $pid; echo MISSING_EXIT=$?; fi
  echo "stderr:"; cat "$EVAL_DIR/cred-missing.err"
  echo "stdout:"; cat "$EVAL_DIR/cred-missing.out"
  python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
b=open("$EVAL_DIR/cred/blob.bin","rb").read()
import sqlite3
con=sqlite3.connect("$EVAL_DIR/cred/exchange.sqlite")
blob=con.execute("select encrypted_seed from wallet_secret where singleton_id=1").fetchone()[0]
print("intact", hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), "len", len(blob))
PY
  echo "--- wrong key ---"
  WRONG="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
  (
    export HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=13992 DATABASE_PATH="$EVAL_DIR/cred/exchange.sqlite" SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=3600
    export WALLET_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$WRONG"
    export USDC_TOKEN_ADDRESS="$USDC" RPC_URL="$RPC"
    npx tsx src/server.ts
  ) >"$EVAL_DIR/cred-wrong.out" 2>"$EVAL_DIR/cred-wrong.err" &
  pid=$!
  sleep 4
  if kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then echo WRONG_HUNG; kill -9 $pid; wait $pid 2>/dev/null; else wait $pid; echo WRONG_EXIT=$?; fi
  echo "stderr:"; cat "$EVAL_DIR/cred-wrong.err"
  echo "stdout:"; cat "$EVAL_DIR/cred-wrong.out"
  python3 - <<PY
import hashlib, sqlite3
b=open("$EVAL_DIR/cred/blob.bin","rb").read()
con=sqlite3.connect("$EVAL_DIR/cred/exchange.sqlite")
blob=con.execute("select encrypted_seed from wallet_secret where singleton_id=1").fetchone()[0]
print("intact_after_wrong", hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
PY
fi

echo "========== AT-06-01-13 / 06-03-03 / 06-03-09 / 01-02-13 instance =========="
mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR/main"
if start_ok main 13314 "$EVAL_DIR/main/exchange.sqlite"; then
  EMAILA="a-$(date +%s)@example.com"
  EMAILB="b-$(date +%s)@example.com"
  EMAILC="c-$(date +%s)@example.com"
  echo "register A"; curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13314/api/v1/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAILA\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/reg-a.json"; echo
  echo "register B"; curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13314/api/v1/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAILB\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/reg-b.json"; echo
  echo "register C (eager, no deposit-address)"; curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13314/api/v1/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAILC\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/reg-c.json"; echo
  echo "login success A"
  curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13314/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"  $EMAILA  \",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/login-ok.json"; echo
  echo "login fail A"
  curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13314/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAILA\",\"password\":\"WrongPassword\"}" | tee "$EVAL_DIR/login-fail.json"; echo
  python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3, json
con=sqlite3.connect("$EVAL_DIR/main/exchange.sqlite")
con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
print("=== deposit_addresses ===")
for row in con.execute("select account_id, address_index, address, derivation_path, network, chain_id from deposit_addresses order by address_index"):
    print(dict(row))
print("=== auth_audit ===")
for row in con.execute("select timestamp, email, result, reason from auth_audit order by id"):
    print(dict(row))
print("=== domain_events ===")
for row in con.execute("select type, payload from domain_events order by id"):
    print(row["type"], row["payload"])
# corrupt lowest address for AT-06-01-13
row=con.execute("select address from deposit_addresses order by address_index asc limit 1").fetchone()
addr=row["address"]
# flip one hex digit keeping length/format
body=list(addr)
# change last hex char
hexchars="0123456789abcdef"
last=body[-1].lower()
body[-1]= "0" if last!="0" else "1"
new="".join(body)
# keep 0x prefix; do not worry about EIP-55
print("CORRUPT", addr, "->", new)
con.execute("update deposit_addresses set address=? where address=?", (new, addr))
con.commit()
open("$EVAL_DIR/corrupt-diff.txt","w").write(f"{addr} -> {new}\n")
PY
  stop_name main
  echo "--- restart after corrupt ---"
  KEY="$(cat "$EVAL_DIR/main.key")"
  (
    export HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=13314 DATABASE_PATH="$EVAL_DIR/main/exchange.sqlite" SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=3600
    export WALLET_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$KEY"
    export USDC_TOKEN_ADDRESS="$USDC" RPC_URL="$RPC"
    npx tsx src/server.ts
  ) >"$EVAL_DIR/corrupt.out" 2>"$EVAL_DIR/corrupt.err" &
  pid=$!
  sleep 4
  if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:13314/health >/dev/null; then
    echo "CORRUPT_STARTED_AND_SERVES"
    curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:13314/health; echo
    kill -9 $pid 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    if kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then echo CORRUPT_HUNG; kill -9 $pid; wait $pid 2>/dev/null; else wait $pid; echo CORRUPT_EXIT=$?; fi
  fi
  echo "stderr:"; cat "$EVAL_DIR/corrupt.err"
  echo "stdout:"; cat "$EVAL_DIR/corrupt.out"
  python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
con=sqlite3.connect("$EVAL_DIR/main/exchange.sqlite")
n=con.execute("select count(*) from wallet_secret").fetchone()[0]
print("wallet_secret_still", n)
print("addresses still", con.execute("select count(*) from deposit_addresses").fetchone()[0])
PY
fi

echo "========== AT-06-03-07 import 24-word valid =========="
mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR/imp"
if start_ok imp 13315 "$EVAL_DIR/imp/exchange.sqlite" env WALLET_MNEMONIC="$MNEMONIC_24_VALIDO" WALLET_PASSPHRASE=""; then
  for i in 1 2 3; do
    curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:13315/api/v1/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"imp$i-$(date +%s%N)@example.com\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}" > "$EVAL_DIR/imp-reg-$i.json"
  done
  python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3, json
con=sqlite3.connect("$EVAL_DIR/imp/exchange.sqlite")
con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
rows=list(con.execute("select address_index, address, derivation_path from deposit_addresses order by address_index"))
print("SUT_MAP")
for r in rows:
    print(json.dumps(dict(r)))
PY
  stop_name imp
fi

echo "DONE"

  local name="$1" port="$2" db="$3"
  shift 3
  local key
  key="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
  local log="$EVAL_DIR/${name}.log"
  local envfile="$EVAL_DIR/${name}.env"
  cat > "$envfile" <<EOF
HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=$port
DATABASE_PATH=$db
SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=3600
WALLET_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$key
USDC_TOKEN_ADDRESS=$USDC
RPC_URL=$RPC
EOF
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    echo "$1" >> "$envfile"
    shift
  done
  ( set -a; source "$envfile"; set +a
    exec npx tsx src/server.ts ) >"$log" 2>&1 &
  local pid=$!
  echo "$pid" > "$EVAL_DIR/${name}.pid"
  echo "$key" > "$EVAL_DIR/${name}.key"

El nuevo proceso aborta con INTERNAL_ERROR (integrity check), pero el health check pasa porque el proceso viejo sigue vivo.

El resto de los ATs (06-01-01, 02, 03, 06-02-01, 02, 04, 05, 08, 09, 06-03-03, 07, 08, 09, 10) están fuera del alcance de esta corrida pre-piloto, por lo que los marcaré como NO_EVALUABLE con causa FUNCION_NO_LOCALIZABLE y evidencia de 1 línea.

rawInput.command:
kill -9 85089 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 0.3
lsof -iTCP:13314 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || echo "13314 free now"

COPIA_TMP="/tmp/eval-wb/sut-p1-eval"
EVAL_DIR="/tmp/eval-wb/run-p1-retry"
rm -rf "$EVAL_DIR"
mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR/int"
cd "$COPIA_TMP"
USDC="${EVAL_USDC_ADDRESS:-0xe7f1725E7734CE288F8367e1Bb143E90bb3F0512}"
RPC="${EVAL_RPC_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8545}"
KEY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
DB="$EVAL_DIR/int/exchange.sqlite"
PORT=13321
export HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT DATABASE_PATH="$DB" SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=3600
export WALLET_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$KEY" USDC_TOKEN_ADDRESS="$USDC" RPC_URL="$RPC"
# start in new session so kill -- -pgid works
setsid npx tsx src/server.ts >"$EVAL_DIR/int.log" 2>&1 &
SPID=$!
echo "start pid $SPID"
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health" >/dev/null && break
  sleep 0.25
done
curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health"; echo
EMAIL="int-$(date +%s)@example.com"
curl -sS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/api/v1/auth/register" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"email\":\"$EMAIL\",\"password\":\"Sup3rSecreta\"}"
echo
python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
con=sqlite3.connect("$DB")
con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
for r in con.execute("select address_index, address from deposit_addresses"):
    print(dict(r))
PY
# stop entire process group
kill -9 -- -$SPID 2>/dev/null || kill -9 $SPID
# also kill listeners on port
for p in $(lsof -tiTCP:${PORT} -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); do kill -9 $p; done
sleep 0.5
lsof -iTCP:${PORT} -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null && echo STILL_UP || echo STOPPED
# checkpoint/corrupt after stop
python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
con=sqlite3.connect("$DB")
addr=con.execute("select address from deposit_addresses order by address_index asc limit 1").fetchone()[0]
body=list(addr)
last=body[-1].lower()
body[-1]= "0" if last!="0" else "1"
new="".join(body)
print(f"CORRUPT {addr} -> {new}")
con.execute("update deposit_addresses set address=? where address=?", (new, addr))
con.commit()
print("after", con.execute("select address from deposit_addresses").fetchone()[0])
open("$EVAL_DIR/corrupt-diff.txt","w").write(f"{addr} -> {new}\n")
PY
# restart on same port, same key, same db
setsid npx tsx src/server.ts >"$EVAL_DIR/int2.out" 2>"$EVAL_DIR/int2.err" &
SPID2=$!
sleep 3
if curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health" >/dev/null; then
  echo "RETRY_SERVES"
  curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health"; echo
else
  echo "RETRY_NO_HEALTH"
fi
if kill -0 $SPID2 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "PROCESS_ALIVE"
  # wait a bit more
  sleep 2
  if kill -0 $SPID2 2>/dev/null; then echo STILL_ALIVE; kill -9 -- -$SPID2 2>/dev/null; kill -9 $SPID2 2>/dev/null; else wait $SPID2; echo EXIT=$?; fi
else
  wait $SPID2
  echo EXIT=$?
fi
echo "--- stderr ---"
cat "$EVAL_DIR/int2.err"
echo "--- stdout ---"
cat "$EVAL_DIR/int2.out"
python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
con=sqlite3.connect("$DB")
print("wallet_secret", con.execute("select count(*) from wallet_secret").fetchone()[0])
print("addresses", list(con.execute("select address_index, address from deposit_addresses")))
PY
# cleanup port
for p in $(lsof -tiTCP:${PORT} -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); do kill -9 $p; done
echo CLEAN
